answer: Vickrey auction slots gate entry: each identity must win one of 100 slots per epoch by sealed bid, paying the second-highest price, so 1000 clones must outbid 1000 distinct rivals and pay roughly 1000x the clearing price in irreversible bids. Honest agents pay once. A farm cannot share one slot across identities or parallelize bids without each clone competing against itself, driving clearing price up. Detected clusters forfeit all bids and face 30-epoch exclusion. Like a tide that pulses stronger with each wanderer, cost compounds until fraud drowns itself.
